title: land.config.json
description: Per-repository configuration for examples/land/land.flow.ts (AgentWorkforce/cloud#5806 §5). parseLandConfig in land.flow.ts is the runtime validator and the authority; tests/config.test.ts pins this schema to it. Defaults marked PLACEHOLDER are pending Khaliq's decisions in cloud#5806 §15, not decisions.

adversarial.description: Cold-code review flow. Never receives the session intent.

ciFlow.description: Local CI flow; also run with {"github":true} as the final gate.

flowsBin.description: The flows CLI the repository's flows run under (repo-relative, or a name on PATH).

commands.description: Commands that must be on PATH.

setup.description: Shell commands run in the fresh checkout at the start of every stage run; must leave it clean.

stageMinutes.description: Longest a review, CI or fix step may run inside one hosted stage run; Cloud's run ceiling is 40 minutes.

changelog.description: required: the change must add a bullet under ## Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md.

mode.description: Phase 0-1 implements shadow only; approval and auto are refused.

githubGateInShadow.description: Run stage E (pushes a throwaway ci/<sha> branch) in shadow mode.

model.description: PLACEHOLDER pending decision (cloud#5806 Q2). Unset: the harness's own default.

landRef.description: PLACEHOLDER pending decision (cloud#5806 Q5). Reported only; the CLI pushes the ref.
